description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the ModifyThing class, testing its behavior, JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and validation constraints related to modify operations on 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ModifyThingTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the ModifyThing class, verifying JSON serialization, immutability, equality, and validation rules.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of ModifyThing are immutable, including related classes.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the hashCode and equals implementations of ModifyThing are consistent.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that creating a ModifyThing instance with a null 'thing' throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that toJson returns the expected JSON structure for a standard ModifyThing instance.

methods.name: toJsonWithPolicyIdToCopyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies JSON output when copying a policy ID.

methods.name: toJsonWithInitialPolicyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks JSON output when an initial policy is set.

methods.name: getEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntity returns the correct JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityWithInitialPolicyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies getEntity output with initial policy included.

methods.name: getEntityWithPolicyIdToCopyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies getEntity output with policy ID to copy included.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ModifyThing instance from JSON string.

methods.name: ensuresNoACLInV2Command
methods.description: Ensures that an AclNotAllowedException is thrown if ACLs are present in a V2 command.

methods.name: ensuresNoPolicyInV1Command
methods.description: Ensures exception if policy is present in a V1 command.

methods.name: ensuresNoPolicyIdInV1Command
methods.description: Ensures exception if policy ID is present in a V1 command.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeThing
methods.description: Tests that a Thing exceeding size limits throws a ThingTooLargeException.

methods.name: initializeWithInitialPolicyNullAndWithCopiedPolicyNull
methods.description: Validates initialization when no policies are set.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicy
methods.description: Validates initialization when a policy is to be copied.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicyNull
methods.description: Validates initialization with copied policy and no inline policy.

methods.name: initializeWithCopiedPolicyAndWithInitialPolicy
methods.description: Validates that conflicting initial policy and copied policy throws an exception.
